## Ready to use out of the box

- adb and scrcpy are now built into the installer - testers no longer need to install or locate
  either one. Settings paths are optional: leave them empty to use the built-in tools, or set your
  own path to override. Check for Updates updates the app and both tools together.
- Settings from an older or newer version are no longer wiped when the config file contains
  unknown fields.

## Run your own adb commands

- New command box under Output: type or paste `adb connect <ip>:5555`, `adb shell "..."` and
  similar, one per line. Enter runs, Shift+Enter adds a line, Stop cancels. Output streams live.
- Commands target the selected device automatically, and lines after `adb connect` use that device.

## Devices

- Devices you connect over Wi-Fi are remembered. The device list shows saved devices that are not
  connected right now - click one to connect, or use the pencil to change its IP, port or name
  (its settings move with it). "Add device by IP..." is always at the bottom of the list.
- You can paste `192.168.1.20:5555` or even `adb connect 192.168.1.20:5555` into the IP field.
- A wrong adb or scrcpy path in Settings no longer breaks the app - it falls back to the built-in
  tools. The "Adb Error" dialog no longer pops up on launch when another adb version was running.

See [CHANGES.md](https://github.com/TonciZ/QA-Adbpad/blob/main/CHANGES.md) for details.
